gis_source.measurement_method: Exact exterior ring projected using the project-prescribed local geographic approximation and recentered at its shoelace centroid.

gis_vertical_attributes.field_metadata: The service describes these fields only by name and numeric type; it does not define units, datum, or vertical measurement semantics.
gis_vertical_attributes.model_use: NUM_LEVELS=5 and CountOfFLO=5 support only five diagrammatic facade bands. Other raw values are preserved but not converted to meters or used as surveyed heights/floor datums.

historical_photo_source.provider: Purdue University Stories; photo credited to Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
historical_photo_source.source_date: historic photograph; original photo date not stated
supports: historic roof silhouette only in archival-era image

historic_vertical_and_roof_source.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
historic_vertical_and_roof_source.source_date: Historical information about the 1908 opening; page also notes multiple later renovations.
supports: original building opened as two stories plus a basement
subsequent renovations make current roof and vertical arrangement uncertain

current_entrance_photo_source.provider: Purdue University Stories; photo by Rebecca McElhoe
current_entrance_photo_source.source_date: 2023 article; image caption says current building, exact capture date not stated

geometry.method: Project exact exterior ring using project local approximation: X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274°), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040; subtract shoelace centroid for local origin; extrude only the outline.
geometry.source_area_note: Shape__Area is calculated in native Web Mercator; the ring is returned in geographic coordinates, so its local ground-plane area differs by the expected latitude distortion factor.
geometry.height_status: diagrammatic estimate only; no current measured elevation. The archival two-story-plus-basement description is dated to the 1908 opening and cannot be assumed unchanged after documented renovations.
geometry.floor_height_status: equal visual bands at 3.44 m are a modeling scaffold only; current GIS exposes NUM_LEVELS=5 and CountOfFLO=5 but no field units/vertical definitions, and the 1908 archive describes a different historical state.
geometry.facade: Punched vertical window bays, dark metal frames, brick field, limestone plinth/belts/cornice, and a tall stacked-glass portal composition matching the 2023 Purdue photo. Bay positions and dimensions are visual estimates from uncalibrated photos.
geometry.entry_location: Estimated at the midpoint of the longest south-facing segment; photo identifies the glazed entrance but GIS contains no doorway location.
geometry.roof: Simple neutral flat cap, explicitly a constrained placeholder rather than a claim about the present roof. Purdue Archives documents a tile roof at the 1908 opening, but also documents later renovations; the current photo does not show the roof.
geometry.interior: Not modeled; no verified floor-plan source was located.

geometry_edits: New source library rebuilt from scratch as a single structural shell using GIS feature 267.
Added estimated masonry base, story courses, cornice and repeated punched-window bays using photo-supported brick/limestone palette.

Reworked the estimated glazed south entrance as a tall, narrow stacked-glass portal with paired lower door leaves, mullions, stone jambs and lintel, matching the composition in Purdue’s captioned 2023 entrance photograph.

Kept a neutral flat roof cap and diagrammatic vertical envelope because available vertical GIS fields lack units/definitions and the present roof is not shown; recorded the documented 1908 tile roof as historical, not current.
Added preview-only cameras, light and ground outside the exported building collection.
uncertainties: The GIS ring identifies the correct building by FID 267, AGAD code, name and address; it is a published footprint, not a boundary survey. Shape__Area is native Web Mercator area while the returned ring is WGS84 and converted to local ground meters.

Purdue Archives records the 1908 opening as two stories plus a basement with a tile roof, and records later renovations. The current GIS separately reports NUM_LEVELS=5 and CountOfFLO=5; the service exposes no vertical-field units or definitions. The model's 17.2 m envelope and 3.44 m equal bands are deliberately diagrammatic, not a measured current height or floor spacing.
The gray flat cap is a neutral placeholder because current roof form is not visible in the modern photo; the archive's tile roof is evidence for the original 1908 state only.

The 2023 image supports the present brick/stone facade and a tall, narrow glazed entrance composition. The doorway location, height, number of panes, facade bay spacing and window dimensions remain estimated from an uncalibrated image and GIS has no doorway point.
No verified floor plans, facade elevations, construction drawings, current aerial measurement, or Street View calibration were located for this build.
The building outline has one exterior ring and no interior rings in the checked feature; no separate courtyard holes are represented.
